name: superbee-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Superbee, a minimal, filesystem-first OKF knowledge store. The publishable successor artifact is the `@holaxis/superbee` CLI (packages/cli), which bundles core, the reference server, and UI assets.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @superbee/core -w @superbee/board-git -w @superbee/server -w @superbee/view-runtime -w @superbee/ui-server -w @superbee/markdown-renderer -w @superbee/mcp-app && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:scripts: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/package-core-external-proof.test.mjs scripts/package-server-external-proof.test.mjs scripts/oss-hosted-boundary.test.mjs scripts/verify-npm-package.test.mjs scripts/mutation-survivors.test.mjs scripts/migrate-legacy-view-names.test.mjs scripts/rename-literal-inventory.test.mjs scripts/release-state.test.mjs scripts/release-audit-tags.test.mjs scripts/release-operations.test.mjs scripts/release-receipts.test.mjs scripts/release-ordering.test.mjs scripts/release-inspect-recovery.test.mjs scripts/release-verify-registry.test.mjs scripts/release-candidate.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:npm-package && npm run check:skill -w @holaxis/superbee && npm run test:browser -w @superbee/mcp-app && npm run e2e:gate -w @superbee/ui
